note: Machine-readable Hold Up character style limits, measured from the approved cooper. Ranges leave room for different ages, builds and roles; they are review triggers, not approval. Prose and examples: docs/CHARACTER-STYLE-GUIDE.md.

render.outline: one dark, slightly warm ink line around every silhouette (cooper: #1E1A16); no outlines inside a limb chain

proportions.note: Stylized, compact bodies with a large readable head. Builds may differ (lanky, stocky, short, tall); keep the head big enough for the face to read on a phone.

face.eyes: solid dark vertical ovals; no whites, irises, lashes or highlights
face.brows: short, thick, dark arcs that carry most of the expression
face.nose: none, or a single small mark at most
face.mouth: a simple line, arc, O or D shape; open mouths show a dark interior and a small tongue
face.facialHair: allowed as one simple dark shape (moustache, beard) with the same outline weight

color.palette: muted, period-appropriate earth tones; one warm accent at most (buttons, a scarf, a badge)
color.skin: any natural skin tone; keep clear value separation from collar and hair

shading: flat colour; one soft shade layer only if a design needs it (none on the cooper)
detail: consistent, low complexity: a handful of design lines (seams, cuffs, pocket) per garment; no texture, hatching or gradients

readability.note: Measured by tools/characters/metrics.mjs on rendered frames

artwork.background: plain, light and even; no scene behind the figure

required: 3/4 view, full body, facing screen right

sheet: expression row (the required set at least)
separate drawings of removable accessories (hat, tools, weapons)
forbidden: copies or close imitations of another creator's characters
likeness of a real living person
logos, watermarks or text over the figure
